 The Bruins will continue their November homestand Saturday when they welcome the Wild to TD Garden.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Boston has just one more road game remaining on its schedule this month, giving the team an opportunity to take advantage of an extended stretch at home. The Bruins will look to bounce back after having their four-game winning streak snapped Thursday in a 5-2 loss to the Canadiens.
 The Wild enter the matchup riding a 10-game point streak, led by Matt Boldy, who recorded his second hat trick of the season against Toronto. The Bruins will have a difficult test ahead as they look to get back on track against one of the NHL's hottest teams.
 NESN will provide live coverage of Saturday's game between the Bruins and Wild.
